data.summary: Landed in commit 238ce7e; step 8 (demoting the two parked tasks to held) executes post-deploy at this drain session's wrap-up. Core: StatusInbox/StatusHeld constants; only open is claimable; replay validates vocabulary via knownStatus, never transitions; NewReplayer now auto-registers catalog upcasters so no caller can forget them. EVENT DECISION: task.created gained a status field (empty = open, the v1 reading) and task.created/task.updated bumped to v2 with identity upcasters. Verified empirically: a v1-only binary decoding status:"inbox" drops the unknown field and mints the task OPEN AND CLAIMABLE (silent mis-bucketing), so "additive fields never bump" doesn't apply — a field whose absence implied a default its presence contradicts is breaking in additive clothing. At v2, old binaries hit the upcast gate: "schema version above this binary's — upgrade tuhdoo", fail-safe read-only (proved live with a pristine-tree binary against v2 bytes: DEGRADED status, 0 ready, writes rejected 503). Accepted consequence documented in T3: once any peer writes v2, un-upgraded peers go read-only. MCP: create_task items take optional status open/inbox/held (create-into-held permitted — permissive by design; born-done/cancelled rejected); update_task accepts all five; get_backlog returns inbox and held arrays (creation order); claim_next/claim_task never serve shelved tasks (tested at HTTP and MCP layers). One-shot + views + TUI: Held above Inbox as dim bottom sections; rows enter detail; c archives both; blocked reasons annotate shelved deps; views FormatVersion 3. TUI quick-capture: `i` in armed panes opens single-line input creating a title-only inbox task as the steering actor; absent in --watch; y/n-free. Docs: dated notes in 001 D5, 002 T3/T5/T7, agent-protocol.md (capture cheap, promote deliberate; the prompts bar applies at promotion). E2E: scratch daemon verified capture→sync→promote→claim round-trips and the old-binary fail-safe; scratch cleaned up; live daemon untouched. make test lint green. FLAGGED FOR BRANDON: (1) the mixed-fleet consequence — first v2 write puts un-upgraded peers read-only; conditional versioning was judged too clever. (2) replay accepts born-done/cancelled in task.created payloads (write surfaces reject them) — consistent with no-rejected-event-edge-cases. NOTE: live daemon still runs pre-inbox code until wrap-up deploy; do not create inbox/held tasks via this session's MCP before then (it would be rejected).
